body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and reduce the target's Defense by 1 until the end of this turn. If it was already Exposed, it also burns 1 die.

surges.html: On a success, the target burns 1 die from its available pool.
Deal +1 weapon damage; you suffer -1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: BREAKER
rider.html: Before rolling, you may spend 1 Combo to ignore 1 Defense against this Action.
